extracted.name: Dijon Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This Dijon chicken salad recipe uses canned chicken along with seedless red and green grapes, dried cranberries, and celery for a tasty, light lunch.
instruction_lines: Mix together chicken, celery, green grapes, red grapes, cranberries, and chives in a large bowl.
Whisk together honey, mustard, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Pour over chicken mixture and stir to coat.
